title: Version 1.60.0
html:
Version 1.60.0 (🏜 The Refinery Desert Update! ( PART 1 )

June 28th, 2024

Added:

  • The desert has been ENTIRELY REVAMPED! A new cave system, areas, a store, and more!
  • The Resource Hub is in an all new design, yipee!!!!!
  • New trees! Queen Palm, Baobab, and Bone (returned from Halloween)
  • New rocks!!! Terracotta, Red Sandstone, and Sandslate
  • New ores!!! Red Sand and Boomite
  • A store in the desert has appeared, Dugg's Digging!
  • Added barrels, 4 new explosives, a launcher, and more!
  • Added a miner's helmet!
  • A new heist is now possible, the glass ducky heist, good luck figuring it out!
  • A new vinyl is here, made by The_OvertimeGamer, have fun finding it
  • A mini crate has been added as an early game alternative to crates (located in The Oak Depot)
  • Added a creator code ATM, can be used to redeem exclusive sign rewards! Check out the YouTubers: TheOfficialBrick, TeamView, & lostvorce for their codes!

Changes:

  • A bunch of new property signs are now available
  • Rocks now have all new appearances! Some are special to their rock type
  • There is now a clock label to tell you the current time of day

Fixes:

  • Disabled character turning due to it randomly moving the head into the body
  • Made the schematic sizing labels work a better with smaller schematic sizes
  • The Blueprint Fabricator can now be used by other players on your base correctly
  • Fixed the build menu not scaling nicely on tablets and other 'square' ratio devices

Version 1.60.1

June 28th, 2024

Fixed:

  • Fixed the refinery and forge not accepting some specific rock sizes
  • Fixed the glass ducky randomly shattering on invisible parts
  • Fixed the classic joop not having a license plate
